# Snapforge Lab

> Snapforge Lab is an independent Replit specialist studio. We review, fix and deploy Replit and Replit Agent apps, and build custom business apps (dashboards, CRMs, client portals, AI assistants) on Replit at fixed prices, for clients worldwide.

## Services
- [Replit Deploy Fix](https://snapforgelab.com/replit-app-to-production/#pricing): $49 fixed price to fix one Replit deployment or configuration blocker (failing build or publish, secrets, database connection, custom domain) in 48 hours, full refund if not fixed ($49 credited toward the Ship-Ready Review if booked within 30 days).
- [Ship-Ready Review](https://snapforgelab.com/replit-app-to-production/): $199 production-readiness audit of a Replit Agent app, delivered in 48 hours, full refund if fewer than 3 real issues are found.
- [Ship-It Sprint](https://snapforgelab.com/replit-app-to-production/): $990 fixed price to fix a Replit app and deploy it to production in 5 days (review fee credited).
- [Starter Build](https://snapforgelab.com/#pricing): custom business app on Replit, $2,500 fixed ($1,500 for founding clients), live in about 7 days.
- [Care](https://snapforgelab.com/#pricing): $249/month hosting, monitoring and improvements.
- [Hire a Replit developer](https://snapforgelab.com/hire-replit-developer/)

## Free tools
- [Replit Readiness Score](https://snapforgelab.com/tools/replit-readiness-score/): 2-minute self-assessment that scores whether a Replit app is ready for real users.

## Guides
- [Is Replit production-ready? An honest answer for business apps](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/is-replit-production-ready/): Can you run a real business app on Replit? What the platform handles well, where AI-built apps usually fall short, which apps are a good fit, and a 10-point test before you launch.
- [Replit Agent security checklist: 15 checks before you launch](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-agent-security-checklist/): 15 security checks for Replit Agent apps before launch: secrets, authorization, validation, data, dependencies and costs, with how to test and fix each.
- [How to deploy a Replit app to production, step by step](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/deploy-replit-app-to-production/): A practical launch runbook for Replit apps: pick the right deployment type, set production secrets, prepare the database, connect a custom domain, add monitoring and plan rollbacks.
- [Replit Autoscale vs Reserved VM vs Static vs Scheduled: which deployment should you choose?](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-deployment-types/): Autoscale, Reserved VM, Static or Scheduled? How each Replit deployment type works, cold starts, background jobs and costs, plus a 30-second decision tree.
- [Replit Agent keeps breaking your app? How to stop the fix loop](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-agent-keeps-breaking-app/): Why Replit Agent gets stuck fixing one bug and breaking another, how to roll back safely with checkpoints, and a prompting workflow that stops the loop and your credit bill from spiraling.
- [Replit development vs production database: how it works, and how not to lose data](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-production-database/): How Replit's dev and production databases work, what Agent can't touch, how schema changes reach production, and 5 habits to never lose customer data.
- [Replit Agent costs: 12 ways to cut your bill without slowing down](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-agent-costs/): Why Replit Agent bills climb under effort-based pricing, where the money actually goes (Agent, deployments, databases), and 12 practical habits to keep your monthly spend predictable.
- [Replit Secrets: how to store API keys safely](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-secrets-api-keys/): How Replit Secrets work, how to read them in Node.js and Python, how to keep keys out of the browser and out of Agent chats, and what to do if a key was ever exposed.
- [Replit vs Lovable vs Bolt for business apps: which should you choose?](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-vs-lovable-vs-bolt/): An independent comparison of Replit, Lovable and Bolt for real business apps: backend and database, deployment, background jobs, code ownership and what each is best at.
